summaries.name: Yamaha P-255
summaries.summary: A $999 professional-grade, weighted-key digital piano with a wide range of sounds, including Yamaha's CFIII concert grand piano sound.

summaries.name: Yamaha CP4
summaries.summary: A $999 professional-grade stage piano with a wide range of sounds and a lightweight, portable design.

summaries.name: Fender Deluxe Reverb
summaries.summary: A $799, 22-watt, all-tube guitar amp with a rich, full sound and built-in reverb, suited for jazz and classical players wanting a warm, articulate tone.

summaries.name: Fender Hot Rod Deluxe IV
summaries.summary: A $799, 40-watt, all-tube guitar amp with a more aggressive sound and a built-in overdrive channel, versatile for various playing styles.

summaries.name: Mesa Boogie Mark IV
summaries.summary: A $999, 25-watt, all-tube guitar amp with a warm, articulate sound and a wide range of tonal options.

summaries.name: Orange Crush Pro CR120
summaries.summary: A $699, 120-watt, solid-state guitar amp with a powerful, articulate sound and a range of tonal options, offering great cleans and overdrives.

summaries.name: Quilter Labs Aviator
summaries.summary: A $699, 100-watt, solid-state guitar amp with a lightweight design and a range of tonal options, easy to transport.
